class LineReader {
    FILE* f_;
    std::vector<char> buf_;
    size_t pos_ = 0, len_ = 0;
    bool eof_ = false;
    std::string spill_;
    bool lastLineHadNewline_ = false;
    bool anyByte_ = false;

    bool fill() {
        if (eof_) return false;
        size_t r = std::fread(buf_.data(), 1, buf_.size(), f_);
        if (r == 0) { eof_ = true; return false; }
        anyByte_ = true;
        pos_ = 0; len_ = r;
        return true;
    }
public:
    bool next(const char*& s, size_t& n) {
        spill_.clear();
        bool haveSpill = false;
        for (;;) {
            if (pos_ >= len_ && !fill()) {
                // EOF
                if (haveSpill) { lastLineHadNewline_ = false; s = spill_.data(); n = spill_.size(); return true; }
                return false;
            }
            const char* base = buf_.data() + pos_;
            size_t avail = len_ - pos_;
            const void* nl = std::memchr(base, '\n', avail);
            if (nl) {
                size_t cnt = (const char*)nl - base;
                pos_ += cnt + 1;
                lastLineHadNewline_ = true;
                if (haveSpill) { spill_.append(base, cnt); s = spill_.data(); n = spill_.size(); }
                else { s = base; n = cnt; }
                return true;

                // consume all, spill
                spill_.append(base, avail);
                haveSpill = true;
                pos_ += avail;
                if (spill_.size() > MAXLINE) throw Err("line too long");
            }
        }
    }
    bool endsWithNewline() const { return anyByte_ ? lastLineHadNewline_ : false; }
};
